obfuscation_indicators: many factors out of our control
strategic decision to take on additional costs
risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and identifies major deterioration in profitability, cash balances, margins, and dividend capacity, primarily tied to project cost overruns and acquisition-related changes. Management presents optimistic forward projections, but meaningful uncertainty remains around backlog conversion, cost recovery, customer delays, and legal contingencies. The inability to estimate potential litigation losses and reliance on non-GAAP forecast information moderately weaken transparency.
